positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration established and verified across the observing band?
positions.why: Both expressions assert the same calibration state — 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates holding across the full observing band — from two vantage points: the lead astronomer's direct assertion (src-1) and the envelope author's decision summary (src-2). The directional read unifying them is the question of how calibration is established and confirmed, with src-1 providing the observational witness and src-2 recording the decision record.
